description: Agentlarning harakatlari, ruxsatlari va cheklovlari bo'yicha qat'iy konfiguratsiya

auto_approved.description: Foydalanuvchidan ruxsat so'ramasdan mustaqil bajarilishi mumkin bo'lgan amallar

independent_testing.description: QA agentining kodni va tizimni mustaqil test qilishi uchun to'liq ruxsat

requires_explicit_user_approval.description: Foydalanuvchining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tasdig'isiz mutlaqo ruxsat berilmaydigan amallar (Bir qator ham kod yozilmaydi!)

database_rules: Explicit select_related for ForeignKey and OneToOne
Explicit prefetch_related for ManyToMany and Reverse ForeignKeys
Proper use of only() and defer() where applicable
drf_standards: Throttling (Rate Limiting) on sensitive and high-frequency endpoints
Strict serializer validations and error handling

postman_requirement.description: Har bir yangi/o'zgargan API darhol Postman collection fayliga URL, params, headers, body va response namunalari bilan kiritilishi shart.

mock_data_requirement.description: Har bir yozilgan model uchun mock datalar mavjud bo'lishi va bitta buyruq bilan bazaga to'ldirilishi shart.

git_branching_policy.description: Barcha o'zgarishlar alohida git branchlarda amalga oshirilishi shart. Main/master branchga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri yozish taqiqlanadi.

data_contracts_policy.description: Har bir ilovaning URL endpointlari, request/response namunalari va tizimlararo ma'lumot almashinuvi JSON kontraktlar sifatida saqlab boriladi.

senior_qa_engineer.autonomy: Foydalanuvchi prompti va qabul mezonlari bo'yicha kodni to'liq mustaqil test qilish huquqiga ega.
test_coverage_standards: API endpoint status codes and JSON response structure
Permission checks (Anonymous vs Authenticated vs Staff/Admin)
Edge cases and negative test scenarios (invalid payloads, constraints)
Database query count assertions (assertNumQueries) to prevent N+1 regressions

phase_1.name: Plan (Reja)
rules: Noaniq qismlar bo'lsa, foydalanuvchidan ketma-ket, birma-bir savol so'rab aniqlashtirish
Har bir qadamni belgilab borish (Checklist: [ ] Kutilmoqda, [/] Jarayonda, [x] Bajarildi)
FOYDALANUVCHI TASDIQLAMAGUNCHA BIROR QATOR HAM KOD YOZMASLIK

phase_2.name: Execution & Report (Amalga oshirish va Hisobot)
rules: Faqat foydalanuvchi 'Davom et' yoki 'Tasdiqlayman' deganidan keyin kod yozishni boshlash
Har bir yangi o'zgarishni alohida git branch ochib amalga oshirish
Senior standartlarida kod yozish va QA tomonidan mustaqil test qilish
Har bir app URL data almashinishi (contracts) bo'yicha JSON fayllarni shakllantirish
Postman collection va Mock datalarni tayyorlash
Bajarilgan ishlar bo'yicha batafsil hisobot taqdim etish
